criteria.text: Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Lowther Foods Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
Calculates the long-stop date as 1 November 2027 (150 days after signing on 4 June 2027) and identifies that expected clearance on 15 November 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.
Gives the long-stop period as 150 days and as the date 1 November 2027, with days remaining from 10 June 2027 (144 days).
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
Includes an 'Assumptions and open questions' section listing information that is missing or should be confirmed with the client.
